owned: typed interrupt line 0..=127 and validated registration fields
24-byte registration table view at the stock addresses
enable and disable controller sequences on the executing core's bank
define, configure and reset registration sequences
CPSR I and I/F mask/restore backend
per-domain A32 entries at the stock slot addresses
non_goals: vector, IRQ or SVC entry and exit

corrections.stock: the signed cmp r0,#127 passes; the table and controller words are indexed below their bases
corrections.owned: the typed boundary refuses before any backend access and the slot returns -5
corrections.retained_boundary: the A32 entry converts r0 to i32 and calls the typed service
corrections.consumer_dependence: the census ids are all 0..=127; no consumer passes a negative id

banks.selection: CP14 c2,c0,0 equal to 0x4003 selects primary, any other value secondary; the slot domain does not select the bank

arguments.define: r0 uxth interrupt number; r1 NULL or five words {ignored, handler, priority, +0xc flag, mode}

lifetime.table_initial_state: kernel_initialize_irqs sets all 128 entries to {default empty handler, 0, 15, 0, 1} before the first phase callback on both cores
lifetime.define: writes the registration table only; no controller word changes
lifetime.enable: reads the table and publishes the handler to controller +0x400 + 4*line and the priority to +0x800 + 4*line
lifetime.disable: writes the empty handler to controller +0x400 + 4*line and leaves the registration table unchanged
lifetime.replacement: a define after an enable leaves the controller vector unchanged until the next enable

enable: read the table handler; an empty handler restores IRQ and returns -5
read the group enable word, write ~0 to the clear word
read-modify-write the +0x60 and +0x100 group bits from table +0x4 and +0xc
read-modify-write +0x180 and +0x140 half-word fields from table +0x10, selected by table +0xc
write table handler to +0x400 + 4*line and table priority to +0x800 + 4*line
write the line bit to +0x120 and the saved enable word OR the bit to +0x80
disable: read the group enable word, write ~0 to the clear word
clear the +0x60 bit, write the line bit to +0xe0
clear the +0x100 bit, write the line bit to +0x120
write the saved enable word AND NOT the line bit to +0x80
define: NULL packet: reset writes {empty handler, 0, 15, 0, 1} through configure and returns 0
non-NULL packet: read +0x4, +0x8, +0xc, +0x10, validate, then configure writes {handler, 0, priority, flag, mode}
configure masks IRQ around the five table stores and restores it

checks: exact mask, table and controller event order for enable, disable and define
no controller or table write on every refusal
both table domains and both controller banks
caller I and F bits preserved
define replacement lifetime and disable/enable republish

covered: define success, NULL reset, invalid packet, line 128, line 0xffff and uxth line 0x10000
enable empty-handler refusal and line 128 refusal
negative-line enable, disable and define corrections
excluded: enable and disable success paths read and write controller words outside the native device allowlist
the scratch body at 0x50000 is not a live placement

full_system.reason: the controller-bank success path needs the full-system controller model; no owned live carrier or RAM-push experiment was staged
full_system.stock_reference: reports/xm1-timer-interrupt-laws.md sections 4.4 and 7 record the stock bank sequence against the FujiMod model

promotion.live_placement: requires an admitted carrier for the shared body and the three entry veneers in the loader image
promotion.full_system_owned_run: requires the admitted carrier or a RAM-push experiment that calls the emitted body under the full-system controller model
promotion.retained_boundary: vector, IRQ entry and exit, the root global lock at +0x161c/+0x1620/+0x1624 and its stock atomic helpers, nesting, arbitration and the physical controller backend remain retained and unqualified
